transit.heading: Transit
transit.channelsNote: Natal: you already have the whole channel · Compromise: the transit holds the whole channel, you have one gate · Educational: the transit holds the whole channel, you have none · Personal Connection: one gate each.
transit.nothingNew: Nothing — the sky adds nothing to this chart right now.
conn.heading: Connection
conn.empty: Save another chart first, then pick it here.
conn.noteNoType: A couple has no Type. The properties above belong to each person.
cycle.heading: Cycles
changes.heading: Changes
changes.note: Times are your device's local time; "in …" counts from the transit moment above. R = retrograde. A direction change (R → D) counts as a change.
ephemeris.heading: Rave Ephemeris
ephemeris.scroller: Ephemeris timeline — scroll with arrow keys
ephemeris.rel.same: Transit on a gate you have
ephemeris.rel.harmonic: Transit on the harmonic of your gate — a temporary channel
ephemeris.hint: Click the ephemeris to calculate the transit at that moment. Scroll sideways to see further.
ephemeris.helpScroll: Scrolling sideways — mouse: hold Shift and turn the wheel, or drag the scroll bar · trackpad: swipe left/right with two fingers · phone: swipe left/right on the ephemeris. Reaching either edge loads more time.
ephemeris.helpClick: Click (or tap) any point to calculate the transit at that moment; the blue line moves there.
ephemeris.helpColors: Each bar is one gate.line, as long as the planet stays in it. Grey: transit only · blue-grey: the transit is on a gate you have · green: the transit is on the harmonic of your gate, forming a channel for that period · both colours: both at once. R = retrograde.
ephemeris.helpLive: To follow the sky in real time, turn on "Live" in the Transit panel: the moment follows the clock and you are told whenever a line changes.
cycle.note.local: Moments in local time at the birth place ({zone}). Solar and Lunar returns are the ones falling in the current calendar year / month.
cycle.note.ut: Moments in UTC. Solar and Lunar returns are the ones falling in the current calendar year / month.
watch.heading: Activation Watch
transit.liveNote: Following real time — recalculated every 30 seconds; you'll be told when a planet changes line.
